note: USFS campground above Gibson Reservoir in the Helena-Lewis & Clark NF (Rocky Mountain RD), two loops (upper/lower). From Augusta, Manix Street west ~4 mi, then ~22 mi west on Forest Road 108, much of it unpaved. Mandatory food storage (bears). The cement boat ramp is 1/2 mile away and the Forest Service 'highly recommends' 4WD to reach it; trails lead into the Bob Marshall Wilderness. Not on recreation.gov. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page: confirmed $15 single / $5 extra vehicle, 26 sites, vault toilets, no potable water; added season (late spring to early fall, varies). Not stated: reservations/FCFS (derived 'always' left; no recreation.gov listing exists), trailer length (derived 35 ft left; the page no longer gives one), stay limit. Alerts: prescribed fire notice, the NCDE food-storage order, pallet prohibition, and a Park Lake closure (a different campground). Note trimmed of restated values; 4WD recommendation for the boat ramp recorded.
